essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: The Origin: Visakanv's founding statement on reply game as "supporting the OP" vs "speaking your mind" (Sept 2018)

essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: The Frame: Utterances as "invitations to play a game"—the improv/collaboration metaphor that becomes central
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text: Every “utterance” (status, tweet, whatever) is a bit of an invitation, a bit of a proposal. “Let’s play this game”. When strangers read the proposal accurately, and support the game, a shared understanding develops. You can make friends this way.

The best guiding question in life is, “Who do you want to share this life with?”

*Everything else* can be determined from this question. Your ethics, beliefs, actions, habits...
